scope: Actual built editor, real Python document validator, isolated HTTP persistence and real IndexedDB. No live Supabase/private writing.
results: Image insertion preserves selected writing; numeric, keyboard and drag resizing preserve ratio and have one-step undo/redo
Caption writing participates in session credit; deletion/undo restores image, caption and credit; replacement retains caption and aspect ratio
Table insertion preserves prose; real Tab navigation, cell alignment, numeric widths and row/column editing save through server validation
Merge/split preserve cell text and original credit; undo/redo restores the complete table
Pointer column resizing preserves table content and saves the resulting width
Reopening restores image dimensions/alignment/caption, table widths, structure and session history
Images fit five viewport widths; wide tables scroll inside the paper on mobile; image/table controls pass axe checks
Delayed image replacement is cancelled safely across document switches
Oversized rich-paste table spans cannot allocate an unbounded grid or earn typed credit
